source: ADR-0036, 2026-09-28: a fingerprint difference that follows a change of endpoint, or of the fields an adapter reads, is ours, and is recorded with its date and the change that caused it. Add an entry in the same commit as the change, naming every field of the contract check's fingerprint it moves, as <section>.<field>.
